content.description: MakersPlace, founded in 2016, is an NFT marketplace where users have access to tools to create, collect, or sell NFTs and can connect their wallets to buy or sell. Developers can use the platform to view activity, transactions, and collections, gaining insight into on-chain interactions and item catalogs. Each NFT listed on MakersPlace is verified as unique and authentic art by the creator and recorded on the blockchain.
